summary: Backend-only regression testing of the routes/documents package refactor (formerly monolithic documents.py). 11/11 new pytest tests pass covering auth, projects listing, documents list/delete/image/retry/retry-all-errored, upload+pipeline E2E, and AI tools import chain. The specifically-requested inspect.getsource(_build_pipeline) unit test in test_iter36 also passes, confirming the public API re-export contract is preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/documents/__init__.py cleanly re-exports the previous public surface (ANALYSIS_PROMPT_*, EXISTING_MATERIALS_TEMPLATE_NONE, _sanitize_*, _coord, _strip_code_fence, _build_pipeline, build_documents_router). ai_tools.py import chain works — /api/ai/floorplan/generate returns 4xx (validation), not 500.

Package split is clean and each submodule is well under the 700-line threshold. Recommend adding a lightweight unit test for sanitize.py helpers (_sanitize_fixture, _coord) to lock behavior for future refactors.
seed_data_creation: Used existing project(s) from admin account. Uploaded a 1x1 tiny.png doc which reached terminal state, exercised retry, then cleaned up via DELETE /api/documents/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The routes/documents/ package is stable. Note: tests/test_iter36_all_drawing_types_traced.py has an unrelated E2E test (test_framing_like_upload_populates_walls_via_opencv) that failed with status=error on a fixture drawing — this appears to be an AI-vision-runtime concern for a specific complex fixture, NOT a refactor regression. The requested inspect.getsource(_build_pipeline) test (test_drawing_types_contains_non_floor_plans) passes.
rca of the issue: N/A — no refactor regressions found. The single failing test in the older iter36 suite is an AI pipeline outcome on a specific fixture, orthogonal to the package split.
